title: Private jet charter to and from Miami
description: Private flights to and from Miami: Miami International's General Aviation Center and Opa-locka Executive compared on customs, permission and runways.
h1: Private flights to and from Miami
lead: Miami has round-the-clock customs for private flights at its main airport, and a dedicated executive airport. How they compare, from official sources.

p: Miami International has {{kmia.runway}}. Private flights use the General Aviation Center, run by the Miami-Dade Aviation Department, with {{kmia.customs}}, and {{kmia.ppr}}.
The executive airport is {{kopf.hours}}. It has {{kopf.runway}}, and {{kopf.customs}}.

Every person travelling needs a valid passport and any visa the country asks for. The operator and its handling agent arrange customs, immigration and ground handling for your arrival and departure, and tell you where to meet the crew.

Your trip brief names the airport, where private flights are handled and the contact on the ground. Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Miami
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We compare the airports around Miami for your times and your aircraft, find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator before you see a quote, and name the operator in your quote and agreement. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: Which Miami airport clears customs at night?
Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
